response_data.name: tc_answering
response_data.context: false means this call must not be handled by the assistant

response_data.name: tc_prompt
response_data.context: the owner's instructions and the approved facts to answer from

response_data.name: tc_after_hours
response_data.context: true when the office is closed right now

response_data.name: tc_booking_enabled
response_data.context: true only when real appointment booking works on this call; otherwise never offer a time

response_data.name: tc_texts_enabled
response_data.context: true only when text_me_details may be used

response_data.name: tc_transfer_normal
response_data.context: number to transfer to for 'talk to a person'; empty means do not transfer

response_data.name: tc_transfer_backup
response_data.context: number to try if the first does not answer

response_data.name: tc_transfer_emergency
response_data.context: number to transfer emergencies to, at any hour

response_data.name: tc_policy_kind
response_data.context: set when this caller must not get the assistant

response_data.name: tc_policy_message
response_data.context: what to say to that caller before ending the call
